performance.measurement: One complete serial suite run per backend on identical source and compiler binaries; includes Cargo, runtime, structural and library checks; excludes compiler builds and focused repetitions. This is not an isolated solver benchmark.

restrictions: This qualifies the narrower repaired M3 baseline, not the 790-client/2198-check restoration inventory.
Expected unsupported diagnostics describe unsupported syntax/features; matching them is not feature support.
The historical mut_wrong_owner control rejects a true restoration claim and remains an incompleteness control, not a false-property soundness control.
Failed-call propagation change 3b9208f05 remains a migration audit item without a standalone reproducer or demonstrated failure in this fixed gate.
Trusted external stdlib implementations and reviewed hash model laws remain assumptions.
R2 ownership/prophecy redesign, full difficult-prefix proofs and value inference have not begun.
stopping_boundary: Stop before R2 and D1-D6; no automation scheduled.
